bounded_contexts.name: managed-k8s-control-plane-host
bounded_contexts.description: Hosted-tier (Kamaji TenantControlPlane) + dedicated-tier (Talos spoke) tenant control-plane provisioning + management-cluster multi-tenancy hardening (ADR-0376). Control plane (provision/observe/teardown); never runs tenant workloads.

ips.title: IP-001: control-plane-host kernel + ControlPlaneProvisioning port + CAPI/in-memory adapters + composition root

adrs.title: Talos + Cluster API + Argo CD fleet substrate
Service mesh: Cilium L3/L4 + Istio Ambient L7

hyperscaler_inv_coverage.circuit_breaker: INV-CIRCUIT-BREAKER-BULKHEAD → the CAPI adapter fails closed (typed ProvisioningError) on management-cluster unreachability; no unbounded retry on the provision path.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: INV-SHUFFLE-SHARDING → per-tenant control-plane provisioning is admission-gated by Cedar (only platform/control-plane-operator may provision; tenants default-deny) before any management-cluster write.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: INV-FOUR-GOLDEN-SIGNALS → provisioning latency + status availability SLIs declared in slos/; saturation surfaced via management-cluster capacity model.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.error_budget_burn: INV-SLO-ERROR-BUDGET → provisioning-latency + availability error budgets per slos/*.openslo.yaml.

data_classification: INTERNAL_ONLY, AUDIT; tenant-scoped control-plane identity (tenant_id, cluster_name, opaque handle) — no tenant workload data
maturity_non_claim: live adapter foundation maturity (ADR-0376 lane): the kernel + ControlPlaneProvisioning port + in-memory adapter + composition root are BUILT and tested; the kube-rs CAPI adapter builds the LTS-pinned Kamaji DynamicObject, maps provider status, guards owned teardown, supports a rollback switch, and records the dedicated Talos reference path. Billing, public SLA, DPIA, external multi-tenant GA, and any real sandbox/live management-cluster action are deferred to explicit follow-on gates.
